sections.name: architecture
sections.value:
Doctrine: .agents/skills/pij-team/TENETS.md — tenets 1-6 govern this document. This repo instantiates them per docs/rules-idioms-architecture/fs3-architecture.md (binding, do not re-litigate): boundaries are crates (arch-allowlist.toml, checked by harness checks); functional core / imperative shell; one composition root (the daemon/CLI config match); testkit fakes over mocks.

Placement for THIS plan (tier rule: pure logic → core · world→types → parsers · port impl → providers · PG → store · wiring → daemon/cli): IngestInput/SourceCursor/RawRecord/SessionFile types + the ConversationSource trait in CORE (crates/core/src/conversation_source.rs — the trait earns existence with four real impls on day one); the four store readers in PROVIDERS (crates/providers/src/conversation_sources/, one module per store); cursor persistence in STORE (a new pg table beside the conversations tables, next free migration number at implementation time — verified 0014 on 2026-08-28); the normalizer in CORE (pure); the orchestrator + CLI verb in the existing daemon/cli wiring; the harness extension in .harness/extensions/convo/. Allow-list grants: providers → rusqlite (metrics-db reader ONLY — one row, already added in phase 1 so no unit edits the shared allow-list); no other new edges expected; any further edge is stop-and-ask.

AMENDED 2026-08-28 (prime ruling SA1, PM evidence): the readers were originally placed in PARSERS. They are IO — they stat inodes, re-glob sidecar directories and open a sqlite database — and crates/parsers/src/lib.rs:1-14 documents its scan as a pure function that 'opens nothing, writes nothing'. Readers are port impls, and this repo's own tier rule sends port impls to providers, which is also the one leaf crate that already ships blocking, world-touching adapters. Parsers stays pure; providers' rustdoc widened from the two enrichment ports to port impls generally.

AMENDED 2026-08-28 (prime ruling SA2): ConversationSource is fs3's THIRD port. crates/core/src/ports.rs previously ended 'A third port is stop-and-ask'; it now names ConversationSource with the four-impls-on-day-one justification (workshop 001 rule 3) and the guard reads 'A fourth port is stop-and-ask.' The trait is BLOCKING, not async: every impl is file or sqlite IO, so the composition root hands it to spawn_blocking exactly as it does the local ONNX embedder, and the trait stays object-safe without async_trait.

PM RULING 2026-08-28 (phase 1, recorded because two task descriptions overlapped): incremental LINE FRAMING — the tail buffer, rotation and truncation detection — lives ONCE in crates/providers/src/conversation_sources/tail.rs, written and tested in phase 1, not three times in three readers. tk-c205's cursor-state service owns what is genuinely its own: durable persistence of the cursor between runs, and the ledger of ordinals a post-rotation rescan is deduplicated against. Detection is per-store and cheap; the ledger is per-conversation and durable.

INTERFACES ARE SETTLED IN PHASE 1, BEFORE FAN-OUT: the trait + types + fixtures + contract suite are the frozen seam. reconvo.py (pinned sha 62b89a89f7035bd8ba077375ffe3e91ae5aa76e650e9cf54b092832302ad82c1) is the reference oracle — a Rust reader that disagrees with the oracle on a fixture is wrong until ruled otherwise. Authoritative inputs, VENDORED into docs/plans/005-convo-ingest/assets/inputs/ on 2026-08-28 (prime ruling A — scratch/ is gitignored, so the original paths resolved for no worktree and for no coder): 09-ingestion-recipe.md (store shapes, cursors, gotchas — treat its 10 gotchas as a test checklist), conversations-telemetry-sample.md (payload spec), reconvo.py (the oracle), fixture-sanitizer-spec.md (PM-authored, binding on every committed fixture). Contradicting the recipe or the payload spec is stop-and-ask, not silent improvement.

RULED 2026-08-28 (prime ruling F): the BUILT intake surface is binding and the telemetry sample is its rationale. The normalized turn type is fs3_core::conversation::Turn — the type crates/daemon/src/conversations.rs already accepts and already enforces payload policy on (512-byte output heads on a character boundary, write-family inputs elided to path plus length, idempotent on (conversation_id, turn_no)). No new payload vocabulary is minted: RawRecord carries TurnRole, TurnSource and TurnItem, so dialects stop dead at the reader and the normalizer is pure arithmetic over a settled shape.

MEASURED 2026-08-28, correcting the recipe (fixture harvest, evidence in each fixture's PROVENANCE.md): (a) the omp session-directory slug STRIPS the home prefix ('-substrate-flowspace-flowspace3'), so it is not the claude '-Users-...' convention the recipe §0 describes and resolution differs per store; (b) omp compaction is a first-class 'compaction' record type carrying summary/tokensBefore/firstKeptEntryId in the parentId chain, NOT the injected user turn recipe gotcha 5 describes — it still maps to a system-source turn and is still never dropped; (c) an omp session jsonl is NOT purely append-only: line 0 is a fixed-width title slot rewritten IN PLACE, which a byte-offset cursor survives only because the slot's width never changes (documented at the top of tail.rs, because it is invisible to both the size and inode checks); (d) omp names a tool under 'name' on the call and 'toolName' only on the paired result, and a tool_execution_start mirror precedes every call, so a naive tool count doubles.

value.rationale: Phase 2 has six genuinely independent units behind a phase-1-frozen trait: four readers (one per store — each a new parsers module, zero shared files beyond one export line each), cursor-state (store), normalizer (core, pure). Recommended seats: FOUR coders, not six — u1c (pij ledger, simplest format) folds into the u1b seat and u3 (normalizer) folds into the u2 seat IF the PM judges either too small for its dispatch overhead (a unit cheaper than its own dispatch is not a unit); PM may run 6 if wave-1 speed matters more than overhead. Phase 1 is solo-PM (serial, small, contract-critical). Phase 3 is the PM composing.

value.name: claude-native reader
value.paths: crates/providers/src/conversation_sources/claude.rs (+ one pub mod line in that directory's mod.rs), crates/testkit/fixtures/conversations/claude/ (harvested in phase 1), docs/services/convo-source-claude.md
value.responsibility: Claude Code session jsonl + subagent sidecars + spilled tool-results → RawRecords with byte-offset cursors.
value.interface: impl ConversationSource (frozen phase 1); per-block merge by message.id; record-type allowlist; sidecar re-glob on every poll.
value.test_strategy: Contract suite over claude fixtures + oracle expectations; sidecar-mid-session and torn-line cases; cargo test -p fs3-parsers, offline.
value.note: Recipe gotchas 1, 6, 9 are this unit's test checklist. Line framing is already built and tested: use crates/providers/src/conversation_sources/tail.rs rather than re-implementing offsets, and spend the unit on the dialect — per-block merge by message.id, the record-type allowlist, sidecar re-glob on every poll, spilled tool-result resolution.

value.name: omp-native reader (+ pij-ledger reader)
value.paths: crates/providers/src/conversation_sources/{omp,pij_ledger}.rs (+ one pub mod line each in that directory's mod.rs), crates/testkit/fixtures/conversations/{omp,pij}/ (harvested in phase 1), docs/services/convo-source-omp.md
value.responsibility: omp sessions jsonl (xd:// remap, toolCall pairing) and pij events.ndjson (seq cursor, receipts) → RawRecords.
value.test_strategy: Contract suite over both fixture sets + oracle expectations; xd:// and compaction-turn cases; cargo test -p fs3-parsers, offline.
value.note: Two impls one seat — the ledger is too small for its own dispatch. Recipe gotchas 2, 4, 5. Line framing is already built (tail.rs); spend the unit on the dialects. MEASURED CORRECTIONS to the recipe, proven by the committed fixtures: the omp slug strips the home prefix; compaction is a first-class 'compaction' record type with summary/tokensBefore/firstKeptEntryId, not an injected user turn; the tool name is under 'name' on the call and 'toolName' only on the paired result, with a tool_execution_start mirror before every call that a naive count double-counts; and line 0 of an omp jsonl is a fixed-width title slot rewritten IN PLACE, so it is the one store that is not purely append-only.

value.name: metrics-db reader
value.paths: crates/providers/src/conversation_sources/metrics_db.rs (+ one pub mod line in that directory's mod.rs), crates/providers/Cargo.toml (the rusqlite dependency row — the allow-list grant itself is already in place), crates/testkit/fixtures/conversations/metrics_db/ (harvested in phase 1), docs/services/convo-source-metricsdb.md
value.responsibility: git-ai sqlite metrics (event_kind=5, both dialects incl. copilot) → RawRecords with rowid cursors, repo-scoped.
value.interface: impl ConversationSource (frozen phase 1); repo scoping non-optional in the public API.
value.test_strategy: Contract suite over db fixtures; copilot dialect case; scoping proven by API shape test; offline via fixture sqlite file.
value.note: ONLY unit granted a new dependency: rusqlite, one allow-list row. Recipe gotchas 3, 8, 10.

value.name: cursor-state service (+ normalizer)
value.paths: crates/store/src/ingest_cursors.rs + crates/store/migrations/0014_ingest_cursors.sql (re-verify 0014 is still free against freshly-pulled main before writing), crates/core/src/conversation_normalize.rs, docs/services/convo-cursors.md
value.responsibility: Durable cursor persistence (tail buffer, rotation → rescan+dedupe) in PG; and the pure RawRecord → ConversationTurn normalizer to the measured payload spec.
value.interface: CursorStore trait over PG (fake for tests) frozen phase 1; normalize() pure functions.
value.test_strategy: In-memory tail/rotation/dedupe tests; PG round-trip in store pg tests; golden in/out pairs for the normalizer with mutation-checked truncation; cargo test -p fs3-store / -p fs3-core.
value.note: Two SRP responsibilities, one seat, zero file overlap between them. Recipe gotcha 7 (live files) + payload spec are the checklists. AMENDED 2026-08-28 (PM, phase 1): line FRAMING — tail buffer, rotation and truncation detection — was built once in crates/providers/src/conversation_sources/tail.rs and is NOT this unit's work; what remains here is durable cursor persistence between runs and the ordinal ledger a post-rotation rescan is deduplicated against. The normalizer's output type is fs3_core::conversation::Turn, the type the intake already accepts — no new payload vocabulary.

value.name: orchestrator + CLI + extension (composition)
value.paths: daemon/cli wiring per composition root, crates/cli conversations ingest verb, .harness/extensions/convo/, docs/services/convo-ingest.md
value.responsibility: Join resolver, ingest pipeline (resolve → read → cursor → normalize → idempotent append), CLI envelope, thin harness extension, first-light proof.
value.interface: Consumes the frozen trait + the units' snap-in recipes; adds no new unit-facing interfaces.
value.test_strategy: Fixture-backed end-to-end integration test + the LIVE first-light transcript (ingest o-prime's session by pij id, re-poll delta).
value.note: PM-composed. Composition is wiring: unit-internal rework here = phase-1 contract defect, stop and get it ruled.

Each coder: own worktree off the plan branch 005-convo-ingest, unit branch merged back by the PM (coders never merge). Fences partition WRITE intent, not the build — wave 1 units share only phase-1-frozen core types, so parallel compiles are safe; if a sibling's tree breaks your build, that is a PM composition concern. Toolchain pinned at phase 1 (rust-toolchain as on main); no unit changes it; done reports carry the observed rustc/cargo versions (tenet 10).

value.steps: Merge unit branches in dependency order onto 005-convo-ingest → paste each unit's snap-in recipe at the composition root → wire the orchestrator (tk-c302) → harness checks green on the composed tree → run the integration proof. Deliberate checks: mis-wiring (right parts, wrong plumbing — count turns end-to-end vs oracle), interface drift from this doc, envelope drift between normalizer output and import payload, stale doc-comments across fence boundaries. RULE: composition is wiring, not building — unit-internal rework here is a phase-1 contract defect: stop, record (harness observe + skill EXPERIENCES.md), get it ruled.
value.integration_proof: tk-c302's fixture end-to-end test PLUS the tk-c305 first-light transcript: real session ingested by pij id, enrichment drained, hit via search --source conversation, re-poll appends only the delta.

value.when: after phase-3 composition, before the PR into main
value.inputs: plan.dd.md + this impl-guide + full branch diff vs main; priority: plan promises (the 8 ACs), composition seams between the six units, interface drift from this doc, correctness of cursor/rotation logic, contract-test gaps vs the recipe's 10 gotchas

value.text: Live files written mid-read (torn lines, growing sessions) — retired by the tail-buffer contract-suite case (tk-c104) and gotcha-7 tests.
Machine-wide metrics-db leaking other projects into the index — retired by API-shape-enforced repo scoping (u1d).
Payload drift from the measured spec (oversized turns burning embed budget) — retired by normalizer golden tests pinned to conversations-telemetry-sample.md numbers.
Trait churn after fan-out (the classic parallel killer) — retired by phase-1 freeze + stop-and-ask; any change is a PM ruling recorded in this doc.

Ingesting our own conversations creates feedback loops (the daemon indexing the session that discusses it) — scope: ingest is on-demand pull in v1; watch turn volumes in first light and record findings for the live-capture plan.
